description: Turn a request into pasteable code in one of eleven targets: curl, fetch, axios, Python requests, HTTPie, Go, Java, C#, PHP, PowerShell or Rust. Emits the import lines and escapes per language, and gets right the things that are habitually wrong (in C# the Content-Type belongs to the content, not the headers; in Go an unused import does not compile).

index.description: Which request, if the input has several

input.description: A curl command, or any supported collection (the first request is used)

name: api_code_generate
